periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Primary axis is tilted approximately 45 degrees downward toward the nasal midline relative to the horizontal axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Vertically elongated ovoid shape; height approximately 1.5 times the width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward tapering with significant black pigmentation extending well below the eye level.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Broad, shallow U-shape across the posterior edge of the dark shoulder band.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: High thickness; band extends vertically from the base of the neck to approximately the mid-thoracic region.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Gap between ear regions is approximately equal to the horizontal width of a single ear.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smoothly rounded convex curvature at the superior boundaries of both pinnae.
